name: heimdall
description: Heimdall — site cloning, fidelity verification and AI rebuild workbench

scripts.check: pnpm -C core lint && pnpm -C core check:docs && pnpm -C console build && pnpm -C core test:fast && pnpm -C packages/mcp test && pnpm -C packages/mcp check:plugin && pnpm skills:check && pnpm run audit
scripts.audit: pnpm -C core audit --prod --audit-level=moderate --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org && pnpm -C console audit --prod --audit-level=moderate --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org && pnpm -C packages/mcp audit --audit-level=moderate --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org
